citeAs: Krizhevsky, A. (2009). Learning Multiple Layers of Features from Tiny Images.
creator: Alex Krizhevsky
description: CIFAR-10 is a widely used image classification dataset containing 60,000 32x32 color images, each labeled as one of ten classes. It is divided into a training set of 50,000 images and a validation set of 10,000 images. It is among the most popular datasets in machine learning, facilitating thousands of research projects per year.
name: CIFAR-10
rai:dataUseCases: Image classification research and benchmarking; training and evaluating neural networks; facilitating research projects including data attribution studies and training variance studies.
